note: A census of the repair checkpoint taken before any content was moved. Each entry is a section that existed at capture time. `unmoved` must still be present in the source. `moved` must name where it went and should no longer be present. `partial` is for a section that gave up part of itself and kept the rest: it must still be present, must name where the moved part went, and must say in `remains` what is left — because a section that is half-moved is the common case here, and calling it either of the other two would be false. This file is read by check-docs, and it is the only thing standing between 'moved' and 'lost' — update it as part of the move that changes a section, never afterwards from memory.
enforceAllAccountedNote: Flipped to true by the ticket that rewrites the checkpoint. Until then a remaining unmoved or partial entry is reported, not failed, so the checker passes while the migration is in progress.
